title: ServerWardenFight
description: This plugin spawns a Warden at worldspawn once per day at a random time between 11 AM and 8 PM, broadcasting its arrival and tracking its health in a bossbar. It can also be spawned manually, and the killer earns 750–1500 Vault dollars, announced in chat
body:
**DM ME ON DC [USER-WolfJTA] IF YOU WANT ME TO UPDATE THIS PLUGIN WITH A FEATURE YOU WANT OR TO HAVE ME MAKE A PLUGIN FOR YOU (FREEE)**

This plugin introduces a thrilling daily event by spawning a Warden at the worldspawn location once per day, at a randomly selected time between 11 AM and 8 PM server time. When the Warden appears, a broadcast message alerts all players, and a dynamic bossbar displays its remaining health in real-time, adding tension and visibility to the encounter. Players can also manually trigger a Warden spawn if desired, making it a flexible tool for server admins or custom events. The player who successfully defeats the Warden is rewarded with a randomized amount of Vault dollars ranging from 750 to 1500, and their victory is announced across the server to celebrate the achievement. This plugin is perfect for survival or RPG-style servers looking to add a recurring challenge, incentivize PvE combat, and create memorable moments for their community.
